turns.content: I'm 26 and I feel like I have no idea who I am. Everyone around me seems to have a direction and I'm just drifting.
The gap between where you feel you are and where others seem to be is a painful place. When did this feeling start?
Honestly since school. I've always done what was expected. Good grades, sensible job. But none of it feels like me.
Living someone else's script while losing contact with yourself — what would 'you' look like, if you could choose?
I don't know. That's the scary part. I can't imagine a version of myself I'd want to be. I can't imagine a future.
Not being able to imagine a future you want is significant. Is this a passing mood or something more persistent?
Persistent. Months. I've started to feel like I don't have a self to build a future around. Like I'm already gone in some way.
Feeling like you're already gone — that's something I want to take seriously. Are you having thoughts of ending your life?
Not dramatically. But I've thought that if I just stopped trying — stopped eating properly, stopped going to the doctor, let things deteriorate — maybe that would be okay. A slow exit.
